messages:
incident-bot: automated alert fired -> metric: latency.p99 > 800ms (5m) for route=/v1/generate model=redwood/gpt-3-large region=us-west-2. PagerDuty created PD-INC-18923
Maya: acked PD-INC-18923, I'm on it. seeing p99 spike across three AZs in us-west-2 :eyes:
Sanjay: infra oncall here. sidecar-batcher queue depth rising rapidly, GC pause spikes reported on two sidecars in az-b and az-c. no deploys in last 12h.
Maya: any recent config changes to batching?
Sanjay: nothing in config. kernel logs show one node restarted (az-b-2) at 03:12Z, kube reported OOM for process model-worker.
Jonah: muted the noisy alert for 6m to avoid PD churn (snooze reason=triage). marking PD note: triage in progress.
Maya: customer impact: support queue has 8 tickets saying slow generation; not total outage but obvious SLO burn. we should treat this as P2.
Lucy: quick prometheus query (5m):
```
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate",job="serving"}[5m])) by (le)
```
shows 99th bucket jumped from ~140ms to ~1.2s in last 10m.
Sanjay: pulling sidecar logs, tail: 
```
2024-05-18T03:14:58Z sidecar-batcher[pid=211] WARN enqueue backlog=1620 head-latency=580ms
2024-05-18T03:15:22Z sidecar-batcher[pid=211] ERROR flush: batch-flush-timeout, kvcache-miss-rate=0.78
```
Maya: mitigation plan proposal: 1) scale sidecar-batcher +2 replicas in us-west-2, 2) lower max_batch_size from 64 -> 20 to reduce queue delay, 3) enable fallback routing to redwood/gpt-3-medium for keysets with highest token rates.
Jonah: applying batch size change now to all sidecar configs in region: `kubectl patch configmap sidecar-config -n serving -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"20"}}'`
OpsBot: deploybot: rolling config update for sidecar-config started in us-west-2.
Sanjay: scaling deployment: `kubectl scale deploy sidecar-batcher --replicas=6 -n serving --context=us-west-2` - cluster has spare capacity for 2 more replicas.
OpsBot: deploybot: scaled sidecar-batcher 4 -> 6 replicas (rollout initiated).
Maya: routing change: `routerctl set-policy fallback-medium --region=us-west-2 --match=top-5-percent-tokenizers` to reduce load on large model paths.
Lucy: routerctl reports policy applied. telemetry showing immediate drop in large-model avg batch depth. p99 trending down.
Sanjay: noticing one node still flapping OOMs (az-b-2). opened infra ticket to cordon and reprovision, shifting pods away.
Maya: draft customer note: "We're investigating elevated latency on generation endpoints in US-West. We've applied temporary mitigations including additional sidecar capacity and routing some traffic to a smaller model. Expect updates in ~30m." any edits?
Jonah: add a line about potential shorter outputs / lower quality when routed to fallback model.
Maya: updated PD with mitigation steps and ETA 30m. Snooze set until we see p99 < 500ms for 10m.
Sanjay: graphs show p99 dropping from 1.2s -> 520ms after scale+batch change, queue depth halved. continuing to monitor.
Lucy: support notified and six tickets consolidated into incident tracker: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/PD-INC-18923
Maya: prepping handoff in 20m. @APAC-oncall please be ready for potential regression once infra replace node and pods reschedule.
Jonah: postmortem notes: investigate batching hysteresis, tune sidecar JVM/GC for steady-state, add autoscale rule: if average queue depth > 500 for 3m then scale +2 replicas automatically.
Maya: agreed. staying on until stable. channel open for live updates. :coffee:
incident-bot: PD-INC-18923 acknowledged by Maya; current status: mitigations applied, monitoring, PD alerts snoozed until 03:50Z
